And set ops to conv3x3-bn-relu which is typically strong.
Let me evaluate that first.<|open|>tools<|sep|><|open|>call tool="evaluate_config" index="1"<|sep|><|open|>argument key="edge_0" type="number"<|sep|>1</parameter>
